summary: Flywire Corp filed an 8-K on May 15, 2026, disclosing the closing of a privately negotiated repurchase of 1,873,320 shares of its non-voting common stock from a pre-IPO shareholder for $29 million, or ~$15.48/share, eliminating all outstanding non-voting shares. The repurchase was executed under its existing $300 million buyback program and follows an announced intention to launch an accelerated share repurchase program. The transaction closed on May 14, 2026. No premium, board recommendation, or advisors were named. Watch for further ASR execution and the impact on share count and EPS accretion.
